title: Editing an event results in a new event being created instead of updating the existing one
description: When attempting to edit an existing lighting event and select a different theme, the application creates a new event with the selected theme instead of updating the original event.
steps: Open the application and navigate to the scheduling section.
Name the program 'Program K' and tap 'Next'.
Select 'EVERY DAY OF THE WEEK' and tap 'Next'.
Tap the dropdown arrow next to 'Themes'.
Observe that 'Program K' now has one lighting event set to 'Theme 20' and 'On' at Sunset.
Tap the pencil icon to edit the existing lighting event.
Tap the dropdown arrow next to 'Themes'.
Select the radio button for 'Copy of Theme B'.
Observe that instead of the original event being updated to 'Copy of Theme B', a new lighting event for 'Copy of Theme B' has been added to 'Program K'. The original event for 'Theme 20' remains.
actual: When editing an event and changing the selected theme, a new event is added to the program instead of modifying the existing one.
expected: When editing an event and changing the selected theme, the existing event should be updated with the new theme, and no new event should be created.
